content.name: Bowl of Commanding Water Elementals
entries: While this bowl is filled with water, you can use an action to speak the bowl's command word and summon a {@creature water elemental}, as if you had cast the {@spell conjure elemental} spell. The bowl can't be used this way again until the next dawn.
The bowl is about 1 foot in diameter and half as deep. It weighs 3 pounds and holds about 3 gallons.

content.name: Bowl of Commanding Water Elementals
entries: While this bowl is filled with water and you are within 5 feet of it, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to summon a {@creature Water Elemental|SRD52}. The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the bowl as possible, understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your {@variantrule Initiative|SRD52} count. The elemental disappears after 1 hour, when it dies, or when you dismiss it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}. The bowl can't be used this way again until the next dawn.
The bowl is about 1 foot in diameter and half as deep. It holds about 3 gallons.
